clue.text: Henry Bishop, seaman apprehended by meddling primate

indicators.note: to be apprehended is to be caught and held, so the meddling word grips the others inside it

parts.note: a busybody is meddling, so busy
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
AB, able-bodied seaman

explanation.surface: A man called Henry Bishop and a sailor are seized by an interfering ape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Henry Bishop' looks like one name (the composer of Home, Sweet Home) but gives two abbreviations.
explanation.definitionFit: The galago, a small nocturnal African primate with large eyes, has this common name.

clue.text: Play cheerful 15 14 in 8 terms

explanation.definitionFit: Noel Coward's comedy about a ghostly first wife is the play in question, an example of the category.

explanation.definitionFit: The brand-name gravy is what gets poured, over a joint of meat, so it is an example of the thing defined.

clue.text: In power increase, 'melting laser-disc' — 15 14s
